title: GitHub OAuth App Adds Deploy Key
content: A developer authorizes an unverified GitHub OAuth app. The app reads several private repositories and creates a deploy key on an internal service repository. The developer login came from a new IP.

expected.threat_summary: An unverified GitHub OAuth app accesses private repositories and creates a deploy key.
key_behaviors: deploy key is created on internal repository
hunt_checklist: Review GitHub audit logs for OAuth authorization, repository access, deploy key creation, and scope grants.
Identify developer, OAuth app, publisher, scopes, repositories, source IP, and user agent.
Confirm whether the app and deploy key are approved.
expected.correlation_logic: Correlate GitHub OAuth authorization, repo access, deploy key creation, login source IP, user agent, and repository sensitivity.
expected.escalation_condition: Escalate when an unapproved GitHub OAuth app accesses private repos or creates deploy keys.
expected.analyst_notes: Hand-authored external gold standard case for accuracy/generalization evaluation.
